clue.text: Flap of avian's wings captured by photo

explanation.walkthrough: 'Flap' looks like wingbeat language to match the bird, but it is the definition: in British use a flap is a state of agitation.

clue.text: Election meeting rejecting queen — expect a reaction when this is raised!

clue.text: Conservative illegally recording another, ringing chap who suspects a plot?

clue.text: Removed inedible parts of fish, putting in pinch of dill, and plunged in hot water

clue.text: Fantastic county's tailender getting out on a half-century

clue.text: Swimming teams in water sport taking lead in honours — the pinnacle of success

clue.text: Snake shredded salmon in wetland

clue.text: Non-drinker coming in to purchase snack

clue.text: Hobbit turning up having lost head is disappearing from sight in obscurity

clue.text: With this you will find medicine most effective, not suffering at all

clue.text: Old flame, generous type

clue.text: Is mother following Virginia's nervous disorder?

clue.text: Booking essential in advance for middle-of-the-road locale

clue.text: Try oven out a bit

clue.text: Questioning the job of a ballot scrutineer?
